ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution between high-intensity (white) and low-intensity (black) pixel regions across both fluke lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Large contiguous white region with fine dark mottling at the proximal margin. Right lobe: Predominantly dark region with a high-intensity white distal tip and scattered circular high-intensity spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 70-degree V-shaped vertex at the central division of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency irregular serration with varying pixel amplitudes (5-20 pixels) along the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex parabolic curve sweeping outward from the notch to sharp, upward-turned distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 15-20 small, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters distributed across the right lobe's dark surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, unaligned linear pixel streaks on the left white field; multiple vertical linear marks on the right lobe distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark linear scars on the left lobe surface; significant irregular edge topography suggesting acquired tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity white spray and water occlusion along the lower central fluke boundary.
